About the Seminar

The seminar brings together contemporary experimental and computational approaches in chemical sciences, highlighting emerging methodologies, interdisciplinary research, computational modelling and data-driven science.

Experimental ChemistryComputational ChemistryDFTMolecular ModellingMolecular DockingMolecular DynamicsData-Driven Research

About Magadh University

Established in 1962, Magadh University is one of the oldest and largest universities in Bihar. Located in historically significant Bodh Gaya, it promotes higher education, research, innovation and academic development through postgraduate departments and affiliated colleges.

Its location near the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Mahabodhi Temple provides a distinctive setting where education, science, culture, history and spirituality converge.

About the Department

The P. G. Department of Chemistry is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and innovation across Physical, Organic, Inorganic, Analytical, Computational and Materials Chemistry.

The Department promotes interdisciplinary research and provides a platform for seminars, workshops, conferences, collaborations, research training and professional development.
